description: Submit a business to be listed on agentready.ch. Prepares an agent-ready profile and emails the company's contact a Stripe pay link to activate. Collect all required fields from the user first. The profile stays private until the company clicks the pay link — nothing is charged automatically.

consent.description: Must be true — the company agreed to be listed and emailed.

contact_email.description: The company's real contact email — the pay link is sent here.

contact_name.description: Name of the person to contact.

plan.description: Optional. agent_profile_monthly or agent_profile_yearly. Defaults to monthly.

name: request_listing
